about: Hand labels for the AI Enhanced accuracy gate (tests/live/test_annotate_eval.py). Each document is planned in AI Enhanced mode with the default presets and an empty SPEECH.md; the labels are checked against what would be spoken, whitespace collapsed. must_keep: text the listener must still hear (content next to removed spans, cited authors who are the subject, years and parentheses that carry meaning). must_drop: spans the presets ask AI Enhanced to remove that the Classic filters leave in (author-year forms, inline page-number fragments, a running head fused into a paragraph, the path of a bare address, odd note markers). tests/unit/pipeline/test_annotate_eval_labels.py checks that every label holds in the Classic output, so must_drop measures only what the model does.
